name: n8-c1-8-universal
description: 8-universal set of 8 points (every planar graph on 8 vertices embeds on it) (Fig. 5)
reference: J. Cardinal, M. Hoffmann, V. Kusters, On universal point sets for planar graphs, J. Graph Algorithms Appl. 19(1) (2015) 529-547, doi:10.7155/jgaa.00374
source: Figure 5 (bottom-left) of the paper, coordinates from the PDF text layer (https://jgaa.info/index.php/jgaa/article/download/paper374/2614/2421)
claim: Each set is n-universal for planar graphs with |P| = n: every planar graph on n vertices admits a plane straight-line embedding on P (Theorem 3: such sets exist for all 1 <= n <= 10).
